rels.name: qualifies (redefine)
rels.definition: A limitation, caveat, anomaly or contradicting readout bounds the scope or confidence of a claim, or contradicts it; the strength of the conflict is carried by the claim's image_support (partial | contradicts) and the audit node's label
rels.why_not_existing: Not a new rel. The current text says 'without refuting it', but three r04 audit edges contradict their target outright: s42114-021 k23->k24 (Nyquist shows no MnO2 semicircle; Rct ranking refuted), k16->k19 (spindle CVs vs 'ideal rectangular'), s42114-020 j34->j33 (plotted strengths 1000x below text). rules_out is for alternatives and contrasts for controls, so qualifies is the only home. A new 'contradicts' rel would duplicate image_support=contradicts on the claim node, which I set on k19 and k24.

merges.into: compare_across_conditions; keep track_feature_across_series only for object identity in frame sequences
merges.why: C1. usage track [17,9] vs compare_across_conditions [98,26]. The r04 case that would have used track in its spectral sense is Acta 2012 p10 (gamma and gamma' (200) d-spacings followed through the creep series). No information is lost without it: the node is OBS/signal/feature_shift, and the reading that the argument uses (misfit reversal at ~10% vs 2-3%, p15) is read from the derived plot with read_trend / read_characteristic_point. The object-identity use (frames, atoms) keeps its own failure modes and should stay.

Q1. usage [8,6] + [2,2] + [5,2]. In r04 I needed the same act twice and had no clean op: s42114-021 k20->k17 (GCD discharge time -> specific capacitance via C = I*dt/dV) and s42114-020 j20->j24 (two plotted sigma(T) points -> Ea via Arrhenius). I typed them replot_derived_series and extract_slope, which hides that a feature is being converted to a physical number through a stated relation. A single quantify op with via = known_relation absorbs both. via was always fillable from the paper in my 4 papers.

Q2. usage [7,6] + [4,3]. r04: j20->j24 (Arrhenius slope, extract_slope) and Acta 2012 p9->p10 (pseudo-Voigt deconvolution of the (200) doublet, fit_model) differ only in functional form. The audit is the same in both: are the constraints and the range defensible? (F5 case c; j24 two-point range). The diagnostic chain stays visible through PRP/diagnostic -> KNW/lookup, not through the op name.

P1+O2. usage PRP/partition [2,2], component_partition [3,3]. r04 test: Acta 2010 n33 (F9b bars: Z, alpha^2, kappa normalised to HH-0) is a textbook partition reading, typed component_partition. All of its content (which term drives the ZT gain, and the kappa>1 audit for HH-7) is carried by the op compare_coplotted_quantities and the label; typing it trend + aspect=partition loses nothing. Acta 2012 load partitioning between gamma and gamma' was naturally MEC/pathway (mechanism_class=load partitioning), not PRP/partition, which shows the leaf does not attract the partition cases it was made for.
O1. usage [1,1]; zero uses in my 4 r04 papers, including a creep paper (the class most likely to draw a deformation-mechanism map).
K1. usage [1,1], [1,1], [2,1]; not needed in any of my 4 r04 papers. Acta 2010 F9b (normalised to HH-0) looks like normalisation but is a partition read, not a collapse test.

indistinguishable_in_practice.note: Specific capacitance at 0.30 A/g (k18) is a single-property headline metric used to rank electrodes: not a composite (FOM), no external pass/fail (qualification), yet functioning as PRF. n34 (ZT) fits FOM cleanly. Suggest FOM definition read 'composite OR conventional ranking metric at a stated test condition'; qualification only when an external criterion is applied. F1 should stay separate on this narrower reading.

Partial consumption of one constituent (PANI oxidised during MnO2 growth; hemicellulose/lignin stripped from the jute surface) is both 'how much of a phase' and 'what the region is made of'. I typed k14 fraction and j13 composition (poor). A boundary sentence (loss of an amorphous/organic constituent = composition with attrs.scope; crystalline phase amount = fraction) would settle it.

Coating coverage on a substrate (uniform CNT network) vs core/shell sheath morphology. I took distribution when the claim is coverage and shape when it is the built architecture, but the two claims are near-identical in kind.
Audit nodes that read one or a few values off a trend plot to test a text claim fit either. Harmless, since the op carries the act; no merge proposed.

comments: Confirmation round: 132 nodes, 187 edges, all 132 typed with existing v03 entries, 0 proposed types/ops/modalities, 2 poor fits (j13 composition for surface stripping; k18 FOM for specific capacitance). Two structural points. (1) Contradicting audits: in both Adv. Compos. Hybrid Mater. papers the figures contradict text claims that lie on or next to the spine (F8 strength axis 1000x below the table, and treated jute weaker than raw; F9b sigma(T) implies Ea ~2 kJ/mol, not 68; F5 SEM texture opposite to 'smoother'; F4 CVs spindle-shaped, not rectangular; F5 Nyquist Rct ranking not visible). image_support=contradicts on the claim plus a qualifies edge carries this well; I ask only that qualifies be redefined to allow refutation (rels entry). (2) Budget practice: with ~4 figure reads per paper, I gave nodes that rest on unopened figures figs=[] and attrs.fig_ref instead of claiming image_support I had not judged. I suggest this become the rule, so image_support is never filled from captions. Notable multimodal operations: s42114-020 j20->j24 (extract_slope then cross_check_consistency: the plotted sigma(T) rise of ~16% over 298-358 K cannot yield the 68 kJ/mol activation energy stated in the text), and Acta 2012 p25 (text-silent: two nominally identical 650 C creep tests give opposite-sign gamma' strain and misfit reversal at ~10% vs 2-3% strain, F7a/b, F8a/b). No packet anomalies (figure ids match captions in all opened images).
